guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: productcatalogservice has the largest anomaly (latency-90 z=+6719, p90 0.0045s to 1.52s), and its memory rose about 11x (1.03e7 to 1.17e8) along with CPU (+433%) and sockets (+123%), while upstream recommendationservice, frontend and checkoutservice latencies are consistent with propagation (recommendationservice -> productcatalogservice, and the worst traces all end in productcatalogservice). Memory shows the largest relative resource change among the productcatalogservice resource metrics, but the CPU and socket increases could also be effects of the slowdown or request backlog, so the fault type is not fully pinned down.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or roll the productcatalogservice pods to clear the memory pressure and inspect heap/memory usage (possible leak or injected memory stress) before and after; scale out replicas if load persists.
